purpose: Three direct model-call runs of the fresh holdout (72 cases) with the prompt frozen on the development split (#227). Quality gate only: no elapsed_ms, so no SC3 claim.
status: frozen before the holdout runs; results added after them

commands.container: docker run -d --name farol-224-ollama -p 127.0.0.1:11434:11434 -v farol-224-ollama-models:/root/.ollama -e OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL=1 -e OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS=1 -e OLLAMA_MAX_QUEUE=1 -e OLLAMA_NO_CLOUD=1 ollama/ollama:0.40.16@sha256:910d0d8107b538fb0894e63163eb195de0cc7aefcbc666dc62d3b18f71124592
commands.before_run: docker restart farol-224-ollama before each run (model unloaded, cgroup memory counters reset)
commands.run: python -I Docs/Research/architecture-investigation/evaluation/run_ollama.py --cases holdout.jsonl --split holdout --prompt prompts/v8.txt --warm-up --out <run dir>/predictions-run-N.jsonl --raw <run dir>/raw-run-N.jsonl
commands.score: python -I Docs/Research/architecture-investigation/evaluation/evaluate.py --cases holdout.jsonl --split holdout --prompt prompts/v8.txt --predictions <run dir>/predictions-run-N.jsonl --out <run dir>/report-run-N.json

runtime.name: Ollama in Docker
runtime.container_memory_limit: none (the Docker Desktop VM limit applies)
runtime.inference: CPU only (no GPU passed to the container)

settings.warm_up: one unscored synthetic call before the cases, own timeout 300 s, recorded in the raw file as id warm-up
settings.input: {"text": <description>} only; no labels, split or tags

prompt: v8, frozen on the development split only (spec 227 D3)

hardware.cpu: 12th Gen Intel Core i5-12450H, 8 cores (4P + 4E), 12 threads; integrated Intel UHD only
hardware.docker: Docker Desktop 4.46.0, engine 28.4.0, WSL2 VM with 8 GiB (8167571456 bytes) and 12 CPUs, kernel 6.6.87.2-microsoft-standard-WSL2

client: Python 3.13.17, standard library, on the same Windows host

repeated_run_gate.rule: the offline quality gate passes only when it passes in every run; the release gate of the local AI decisions (step 6) does not say how repeated runs combine, so the strictest reading applies
repeated_run_gate.source: spec 227 D4, committed before the runs (6bcdae6)
